title: Homeschool Elite Academy
desc: This program is designed to help motivated players maximize their potential while training during traditional school hours

details.tagline: Train During the Day. Develop at the Next Level.
details.body:
The Homeschool Elite Academy provides professional daytime training for homeschool athletes looking to take their game to the next level. Players will train in a challenging, professional environment while developing their technical skills, soccer IQ, and athletic performance.

## Designed for

- Homeschool and virtual-school students
- Elite club players
- College-bound athletes
- Players aspiring to compete at the collegiate, professional, or national team level
- Serious players committed to reaching their full potential
